Prague allegedly blinded the man who built its famous clock — and chemists really did find egg yolk baked into the mortar of the bridge next door. 👀

facts.headline: Legend says Prague blinded the man who built this clock
facts.body_html: According to legend, the city had clockmaker Hanuš blinded the moment he finished the Astronomical Clock's astronomical dial in 1490 so he could never build another one — he responded by reaching into the gears and sabotaging the mechanism, which reportedly sat broken for decades.
suggested_queries: Prague Astronomical Clock Orloj close up dial
Old Town Hall tower Prague clock exterior

facts.headline: Chemists found real egg yolk baked into this bridge's mortar
facts.body_html: Legend claims King Charles IV ordered eggs mixed into the mortar of Charles Bridge, whose construction began at an astrologer-picked palindrome moment in 1357 — a 2008 lab analysis of the original mortar actually turned up egg protein residue, though a follow-up study in 2010 disputed the find.
suggested_queries: Charles Bridge Prague towers Vltava river

facts.headline: This is the largest ancient castle complex on Earth
facts.body_html: Guinness World Records recognizes Prague Castle as the largest ancient castle complex in the world, its core covering roughly 70,000 square meters — about the size of seven football pitches.
suggested_queries: Prague Castle aerial St Vitus Cathedral

facts.headline: A building nicknamed after two Hollywood dancers
facts.body_html: Architect Frank Gehry designed this 1996 office building to look like two dancers mid-move, nicknaming it 'Fred and Ginger' after Fred Astaire and Ginger Rogers — it rose on a riverfront lot left empty since a 1945 bombing.
suggested_queries: Dancing House Prague Rasinovo nabrezi facade

facts.headline: Communist police repainted this wall for a decade — it never stopped
facts.body_html: After John Lennon's death in 1980, Prague's secret police painted over the graffiti tribute to him again and again — but new art kept appearing overnight until the 1989 Velvet Revolution, when the wall was finally left alone for good.
suggested_queries: Lennon Wall Prague Kampa Island close up

facts.headline: Some graves here are stacked twelve deep
facts.body_html: Space in Prague's old Jewish quarter was so limited that when the Old Jewish Cemetery ran out of room, more soil was simply added on top — creating up to 12 layers of burials beneath roughly 12,000 visible tombstones.
suggested_queries: Old Jewish Cemetery Prague Josefov overview

facts.headline: Ten giant babies are crawling up Prague's tallest tower
facts.body_html: Artist David Černý installed 10 giant bronze babies with barcodes for faces onto the Žižkov Television Tower in 2000 — meant to be temporary, they proved so popular they're still crawling up it today.
